The gate run cited above had every required gate pass; G6, G7 and G8 are warn with the warnings listed below.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0], g1_description/scene.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0. The scene includes g1_description/g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml (scene.xml:2), which declares one free joint and 29 hinge joints driven by 29 <motor> elements (g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml:52, :246-274). cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [29 numbers]}}; the bridge writes data.ctrl, runs mj_step for ticks steps and returns the observation {time, qpos, qvel}, tick and state_hash. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward. The state is the bridge's integration state (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed), with 36 qpos and 35 qvel values. The served model step is the MJCF's own 0.002 s (g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml:8). The other card model, g1_29dof_rev_1_0.xml, is served through the scene include, not as a second device: one package serves one device and the upstream simulator loads the scene (deploy_mujoco/config/mujoco.yaml:1, deploy_mujoco/deploy_mujoco.py:29,33).

WHY THIS SHAPE: the upstream is a MuJoCo deployment framework for the Unitree G1; its simulation loop loads the scene with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path, creates MjData, overrides m.opt.timestep with simulation_dt and writes a PD torque to d.ctrl before mj_step (deploy_mujoco/deploy_mujoco.py:33-37, :80-82). MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), and package code never imports the clone, so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in for the mujoco library (fake.py) and the lock names it .fake:fake_mujoco. The stand-in parses the same scene and its <include> for the joint dimensions, the 29 actuators, any ctrlrange and the option timestep, but integrates a placeholder motion of each actuated joint, leaves the free base fixed and loads no STL mesh; it resolves no contact, equality, tendon or actuator constraint. The driver's fidelity gaps list every difference. The clone was not modified and nothing under the clone was imported or run.

NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself was never imported, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the fake is not MuJoCo physics. The upstream simulation overrides the model step with simulation_dt 0.003 from deploy_mujoco/config/mujoco.yaml:2 (deploy_mujoco/deploy_mujoco.py:30,35), while this package serves the MJCF's own 0.002 s step; control_decimation 7, the PD gains and the policy layer are not part of the driver. The FSM, policy inference, joystick and viewer of deploy_mujoco/deploy_mujoco.py:43-106 are not exposed, and the real-robot stack (deploy_real/deploy_real.py and unitree_sdk2) is not part of this simulated [...]
